name: Organization Log 2026-10-01
body:
> Log · 2026-10-01

# Summary
Record of the October 1 2026 top-level cleanup of `C:\TAG Marketing Claude\`. Nothing was deleted or renamed, only moved; any move can be undone by moving the item back from New to Old location. The log is a two-column Old/New table of roughly 200 entries.

# Where things went
- **Alphalete Trenchless Pipelining:**
  - About 90 loose page HTML snapshots, Elementor data JSON, fix scripts and PHP batch files (page IDs 12635 to 12691, Black Forest, Boone) moved to `wp-elementor-fixes-2026-06-12\`.
  - AEO audit and the 2026-06-23 SEO audit to `seo-audits-2026-06\`.
  - Instantly lead and thread JSON to `instantly-outreach-2026-06-24\`.
  - July Monsoon and August Hydro Jetting blog cluster files to `Blogs\`.
  - About 24 Higgsfield featured images to `higgsfield-images\`.
  - Old "Alphalete Trenchless" folder renamed into place as `gsc-indexing-report-2026-08-15`.
- **Pipeliners:** 2026-06-23 SEO audit to `seo-audits\`; June attribution audit, OTTO schema fix, search bid review, Search Atlas ticket and task verify notes to `audits-and-notes-2026-06\`; ePIPE Goodyear scripts to `epipe-goodyear-scripts-2026-06-17\`; blog inventories and monsoon cluster files to `blog-clusters-2026-07\`; review widget coverage to `search-atlas\`.
- **Summit Plumbing Pros:** `drafts\`; June SEO and AEO audits plus title-trim files to `seo-audits-2026-06\`; July/August blog clusters to `blog-clusters-2026-07\`; Search Atlas PDFs and Tempe optimization doc to `search-atlas\`.
- **Prestige Plumbing:** website tracker xlsx, 2026-06-23 SEO audit, July/August blog clusters, logo image.
- **_Shared (All Clients):** all EOD reports to `EOD Reports\`; GBP batches to `GBP Content\`; guides and SOPs to `SOPs and Guides\`; GSC tracker, search-terms log and monday.com CSVs to `Trackers and Logs\`; broken-link and optimization reports to `Multi-Client Reports\`; `Blogs\` folder.

# Why it matters
Older notes, chats and memory may reference the old root paths. Use this table to translate an old path to its current location. The [Session Handoff 2026-10-01 (All Clients)](lib:brain-session-handoff-2026-10-01-all-clients) points here for old-to-new paths.
